name: Choyon
tagline: Computer science student at East West University, working on deep learning for medical imaging.
about: I'm an undergraduate in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at East West University. I'm interested in machine learning, especially self-supervised learning and how it can help when labelled medical data is scarce. This page collects my projects, research and achievements in one place.

research.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Chest X-ray Classification
research.desc: Undergraduate thesis exploring how self-supervised pretraining improves chest X-ray classification when labelled data is limited.
